title: Threat Point
body_html:
Threat Point

Let $G$ be a finite strategic game. The punishment level, or threat point, for player $i$ is $$ V_i= \min_{\sigma_{-i}\in\prod_{j\ne i}\Delta(S_j)} \max_{s_i\in S_i} g_i(s_i,\sigma_{-i}). $$ It is the maximal punishment that the other players can enforce against player $i$ using independent mixed strategies.
